summary: Frontend-only verification of /artisane page layout bug fix. Both desktop (1920x900) and mobile (390x800) viewports show the artisan photo (data-testid=artisan-cutout) BEFORE the h1 text block. Achieved via flex flex-col-reverse wrapping in ArtisanHero.js.
context_for_next_testing_agent: ArtisanHero uses flex flex-col-reverse to place image before text in both desktop and mobile. All 4 badges use hidden md:flex so they only appear on md+ screens (correct per requirements). All acceptance criteria met.
